description: Outline permission for access, scale and layout only: Demolition of existing dwelling and erection of replacement building comprising 8 no. apartments, car parking and associated facilities
decision_conditions: <p>Prior to the commencement of the development (other than works of demolition) hereby approved, further details shall be supplied via a Planning Fire Safety Strategy (PFSS) to supplement the existing fire statement, which shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. This shall include additional information on:</p><p>i) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread</p><p>The development shall be operated in accordance with all approved details in perpetuity.</p><div><br></div><div><br></div>

<p>The development of any buildings hereby permitted shall not be commenced until works for the disposal of surface and foul water, including the incorporation of sustainable drainage features as appropriate, have been provided on site in accordance with details to be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. These works shall thereafter be retained.</p><div><br></div>

Application for the approval of the reserved matters shall be made to the local planning authority before the expiration of 3 years from the date of this permission.  The development hereby permitted shall commence before the expiration of two years from the date of approval of the last of the reserved matters to be approved.

<p>As per the approved details, the ground floor of the development hereby permitted shall be constructed to the specifications of: “Part M, M4 (2), Category 2: Accessible and Adaptable Dwellings” of The Building Regulations 2015 and thereafter retained in that form as far as possible.</p>

<p>All Non-Road Mobile Machinery (NRMM) of net power of 37kW and up to and including 560kW used during the course of the demolition, site preparation and construction phases shall comply with the emission standards set out in chapter 7 of the GLA’s supplementary planning guidance “Control of Dust and Emissions During Construction and Demolition” dated July 2014 (SPG), or subsequent guidance. Unless it complies with the standards set out in the SPG, no NRMM shall be on site, at any time, whether in use or not, without the prior written consent of the local planning authority. The developer shall keep an up to date list of all NRMM used during the demolition, site preparation and construction phases of the development on the online register at https://nrmm.london/&nbsp;</p>

Approval of the details shown below (the "reserved matters") shall be obtained from the local planning authority in writing before any development is commenced:
(a) appearance
(b) landscaping

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until further or revised details of the cycle storage area have been provided, including an external entrance/exit; details regarding internal layout and cycle stands to confirm indicated capacities and details regarding external short stay provision have been submitted and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall then be carried out in accordance with the details as so agreed; the storage provision shall be in place prior to the first occupation of the development; and retained thereafter.</p><div><br></div>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved scheme’s specific details, prior to occupation of the development hereby permitted, the applicant shall obtain a Secured by Design Certification to demonstrate how they intend to minimise the risk of crime in a visually acceptable manner, or supply sufficient justification where the accreditation requirements cannot be met, which are to be submitted and approved in writing by the local planning authority. These Secured by Design measures shall be implemented prior to occupation, and the development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details thereafter wherever practical.</p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall not be occupied, until details of a strategy for the provision of communal facilities for television reception (eg. aerials, dishes and other such equipment) has been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. Such details shall include the specific size and location of all equipment. The approved details shall be implemented prior to the first occupation of the building and shall be retained thereafter. No other television reception equipment shall be introduced onto the walls or the roof of the building without the prior written approval of the Local Planning Authority.</p>

<p>The erection of fencing for the protection of any retained tree on or bordering the site shall be undertaken in accordance with the Arboricultural Impact Assessment Method Statement &amp; Tree Protection Plan by Jomas Associates Ltd (dated 22/08/2024) before any equipment, machinery or materials are brought on to the site for the purposes of the development, and shall be maintained until all equipment, machinery and surplus materials have been removed from the site. Nothing shall be stored or placed in any area fenced in accordance with this condition, and the ground levels within those areas shall not be altered, nor shall any excavation be made, without the written consent of the local planning authority.</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents:</p><p>MIC/MBS0108 Rev 001 - Topographical Survey (2 pages) + [Existing] Floor Plans, Roof Plan &amp; Sections + [Existing] Elevations; 2304-A001 – Site Location Plan and Existing Block Plan; 2304-A121a – Block Plan; 2304-A220b – Ground Floor Layout; 2304-A122 – Site Dimensions; 2304-A221 – First Floor Layout; 2304-A221 – First Floor Layout; 2304-A222 – Second Floor Layout; 2304-A223 – Indicative Front and Side Elevations; 2304-A224 – Indicative Rear and Side Elevations; 2304-A225 – Site Section; Planning Statement by Rackham Planning (dared July 2024); Design and Access Statement (dated Jul 2024); 2401950-ACE-XX-00-RP-C-0101-1.1 Transport Statement by Ardent Consulting Engineers; (dated July 2024); Arboricultural Impact Assessment Method Statement &amp; Tree Protection Plan by Jomas Associates Ltd (dated 22/08/2024); Fire Safety Statement by Rackham Planning; Ecology Report by Cherryfield Ecology; Bat Emergence Survey by Cherryfield Ecology; Statutory Biodiversity Metric Calculation Tool; Biodiversity Net Gain (BNG)/Biological Impact Assessment (BIA) by Cherryfield Ecology; Dynamic Summertime Overheating Analysis by OG Energy; Energy and Sustainability Statement by OG Energy (dated 9 May 2024)</p><p>All documents received and valid 10.07.24</p>

<p>No site works or development shall commence until details of the levels of the building(s), hardstanding and terrace areas in relation to the adjoining land and highway(s), and any other changes proposed in the levels of the site, have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority.&nbsp; The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p>Prior to the usage of the proposed balcony areas, full details of their associated privacy screening (including location, height, fixings and materials) to be installed on the eastern edges at first and second floor levels, shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority.&nbsp; The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p><p><br></p>

<p>The development hereby approved shall not be first occupied until the proposed car parking spaces, as shown on plan reference 2304-A101a, and the associated eight active electric vehicle charging points have been fully implemented, and retained thereafter</p><div><br></div>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans, the development hereby permitted shall not be occupied until further details of planned refuse and recycling strategy for the site are provided to ensure the internal storage area is viable, including details regarding drag distance to highway; anticipated positioning of bins on collection day and storage capacity, to be submitted and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The development shall then be carried out in accordance with the details as so agreed; the storage provision shall be in place prior to the first occupation of the development; and retained thereafter. The refuse and recycling bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, within this approved designated refuse storage area.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p>

<p class="MsoNormal">Notwithstanding
the approved details, the development hereby approved shall not commence unless
a Biodiversity Gain Plan has been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.
The Biodiversity Gain Plan must include the following (where relevant):</p><p class="MsoNormal">(a)
information about the steps taken or to be taken to minimise the adverse effect
of the development on the biodiversity of the onsite habitat and any other
habitat;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">(b)
the pre-development biodiversity value of the onsite habitat;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">(c)
the post-development biodiversity value of the onsite habitat;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">(d)
any registered offsite biodiversity gain allocated to the development and the
biodiversity value of that gain in relation to the development;<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">(e)
any biodiversity credits purchased for the development; and<o:p></o:p></p><p class="MsoNormal">(f)
any such other matters as the Secretary of State may by regulations specify.</p><p>

















</p><p class="MsoNormal">The
development shall be carried out strictly in accordance with the approved
Biodiversity Gain Plan.<span style="font-family: Calibri, sans-serif;"><o:p></o:p></span></p>

<p>No development shall take place, including any works of demolition, until a Construction Method Statement has been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority in accordance with the format and guidance provided by Transport for London – www.tfl.gov.uk. The Construction Method Statement shall provide for:</p><p>a) Parking of vehicles of site operatives/visitors.</p><p>b) HGV access to site – loading and unloading of plant and materials.</p><p>c) Number of HGV’s anticipated.</p><p>d) Storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development.&nbsp;</p><p>e) Programme of work and phasing.&nbsp;</p><p>f) Site layout plan.&nbsp;</p><p>g) Highway condition (before, during, after).</p><p>h) Measures to control dust and dirt during construction.</p><p>i) A scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works; and</p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved Construction Method Statement, or any amendment or variation to it as may be agreed in writing by the local planning authority.</p><div><br></div>

All fenestration (including glazed stairwells in the east elevation above ground floor level of the proposed development shall:
(a) be of purpose-made obscure glass,
(b) be permanently fixed closed below a height of 1.7m above finished floor level,
and shall thereafter be retained in that form.
